title: AI Chatbot
shortDescription: A conversational AI chatbot for customer support.
detailedDescription: This project is an AI-powered chatbot that helps users with FAQs and customer support, built using Python, TensorFlow, and React. It integrates with various platforms and provides real-time responses.
contribution: Designed the conversation flow, implemented backend APIs, and integrated the chatbot with the frontend.
challenges: Handling ambiguous user queries and ensuring real-time performance.
impact: Reduced customer support response time by 60% and improved user satisfaction.

title: Task Manager App
shortDescription: A productivity app to manage daily tasks and deadlines.
detailedDescription: A full-stack web application for managing tasks, deadlines, and reminders. Built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and React. Features include calendar integration and notifications.
contribution: Developed the backend REST API, implemented authentication, and created the calendar view.
challenges: Synchronizing tasks across devices and handling offline mode.
impact: Helped 1000+ users organize their work and meet deadlines efficiently.

title: Portfolio Website
shortDescription: A personal portfolio website to showcase my work.
detailedDescription: A responsive portfolio website built with React and Bootstrap to display my projects, resume, and contact information. Includes a blog section and dynamic project gallery.
contribution: Designed the UI/UX, implemented responsive layouts, and set up continuous deployment.
challenges: Optimizing for mobile devices and SEO.
impact: Increased professional visibility and received positive feedback from recruiters.
